name: Adaptive Auxiliary Texture Resolution for Isosurface Raycasting
aliases: Adaptive Algorithm for Accelerating Direct Isosurface Rendering
Adaptive Algorithm for Accelerating Direct Isosurface Rendering on GPU
summary: Adaptive Auxiliary Texture Resolution for Isosurface Raycasting accelerates GPU rendering by using a two-pass method that dynamically adjusts auxiliary texture resolution to predict ray intersections and prevent artifacts without preprocessing.
